statements.impact_statement: GHSA-2w8w-qhg4-f78j is a stored XSS in the Jaeger web UI (fixed in jaeger 1.47.0). Trickster 2.1.0 and 2.2.1 link exactly one jaeger package, github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/model/json (JSON span structs), reached through pkg/backends/druid -> cockroachdb-parser tracing. Verified at v2.2.1 with go mod why -m github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger and go list -deps ./cmd/trickster: model/json is the only jaeger package, so no UI code or HTTP handler from jaeger is compiled in. The build re-runs that go list check and fails if any other jaeger package appears.
